hooks.prompt: Inspect the Bash command. Block these dangerous operations: 'git push --force' or 'git push -f' targeting main/master, 'git reset --hard' on main/master, 'git clean -fd' at repo root, 'git branch -D main' / 'git branch -D master', any 'rm -rf /' or recursive delete of the project root, and any 'gh pr merge' without an explicit user request earlier in the session. Return {"decision":"block","reason":"..."} to block, otherwise {"decision":"allow"}. Allow normal git, gh, npm, and skill operations.

If the edited path matches 'skills/<name>/SKILL.md', verify the YAML frontmatter has both 'name' and 'description'. The 'name' must equal the folder basename (segment after 'skills/' and before '/SKILL.md'). Return {"ok":true} on success or if the file is unrelated, {"ok":false,"reason":"..."} on violation.

If this turn ran any adk skill that has a four-phase validator, confirm Phase 4 (post-execution) was logged to '.temp/<task-slug>/validation/' or '.temp/notes/'. Return {"ok":true} if validated or no skill ran, {"ok":false,"reason":"..."} otherwise.
